'''Ha'laa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] he was posted at [[Carrick Station]].
